name: Arabian Jasmine
hook: Mogra dying over winter? It can't take any frost.

steps.title: Bright, no hot sun
steps.tip: Give it your brightest spot or some direct sun, but shade it from hot afternoon sun.

steps.title: Moist, drier in winter
steps.tip: Keep the soil moist but well drained while it grows, and water sparingly in winter.

steps.title: Frost-free all winter
steps.tip: It tolerates cool nights but not freezing. Keep it indoors or under glass through winter.

steps.title: Low-nitrogen feed monthly
steps.tip: Feed once a month while it is growing with a low-nitrogen fertiliser.

steps.title: Watch for mites indoors
steps.tip: Check often for aphids, scale, mealybugs and red spider mite, which strike plants kept indoors.

steps.title: Root summer cuttings
steps.tip: Take semi-ripe cuttings in summer, or layer a low stem into a pot of compost in autumn.

outro: Bright light, no frost and a monthly feed keep mogra in scented bloom.

sources.title: Florida Museum of Natural History: Arabian Jasmine
